mapper.sql: select d.drama_id, d.channel_id, d.external_content_id, d.title, d.cover_file_id, d.external_url, d.related_work_id, d.source_type, d.authorization_status, d.sync_status, d.copyright_note, d.status, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.remark, w.title as related_work_title, dc.channel_name as channel_name from sys_external_drama d left join sys_drama_channel dc on dc.channel_id = d.channel_id left join sys_work w on w.work_id = d.related_work_id
mapper.update: update sys_external_drama set related_work_id = #{relatedWorkId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where drama_id = #{dramaId}
update sys_external_drama set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where drama_id = #{dramaId}

#{dramaId}
mapper.sql: select d.related_work_id as work_id, w.title as work_title, (select ifnull(sum(play_count), 0) from sys_episode where work_id = d.related_work_id) as total_play_count, (select count(*) from sys_subscribe where work_id = d.related_work_id) as subscribe_count, (select count(*) from sys_episode where work_id = d.related_work_id) as episode_count from sys_external_drama d left join sys_work w on w.work_id = d.related_work_id where d.related_work_id is not null
